creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pass = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_user = 'ch-burch@gmail.com'
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_user, password=spotify_pass)
print(spotify_login)
spotify_token = spotify_login.get('access_token')
print('token_present', bool(spotify_token))

import math
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

def round_half_up(x):
    return int(Decimal(str(x)).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

# Fetch all playlists from library (paginated)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'num_items', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
# Compute total duration per playlist using show_playlist (includes per-song duration)
playlist_durations = []
for i, pl in enumerate(all_playlists):
    pid = pl['playlist_id']
    title = pl.get('title')
    details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    songs = details.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds = sum(s.get('duration', 0) for s in songs)
    total_minutes = total_seconds / 60.0
    playlist_durations.append({
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'title': title,
        'songs_count': len(songs),
        'total_seconds': total_seconds,
        'total_minutes': total_minutes,
        'rounded_minutes': round_half_up(total_minutes)
    })

print('computed_playlists', len(playlist_durations))
# Show sorted by total_seconds ascending
playlist_durations_sorted = sorted(playlist_durations, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
for item in playlist_durations_sorted[:10]:
    print(item['playlist_id'], item['title'], 'songs', item['songs_count'], 'seconds', item['total_seconds'], 'minutes', item['total_minutes'], 'rounded', item['rounded_minutes'])

shortest = playlist_durations_sorted[0]
print('shortest', shortest)
shortest_minutes_rounded = shortest['rounded_minutes']
print('shortest_minutes_rounded', shortest_minutes_rounded)
